items.title: FinRL-DeepSeek Revisited: A Reproduction and Multi-Seed Robustness Analysis of LLM-Infused Risk-Sensitive Trading Agents
items.claim: Single-seed financial backtests undermine published agent rankings by obscuring seed-dependent performance reversals.

items.title: FinProof v1: An Adversarial Benchmark for AI Guardrail Evaluation in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance
items.claim: Generic AI safety benchmarks systematically miss BFSI-specific attacks exploiting regulatory complexity and compliance ambiguity.

items.title: The Operating-Layer Dominance Hypothesis: Why Agentic Trading Alpha Is an Interface Problem, Not a Model Problem A Position Paper on Architecture, Live Evaluation, and Alpha Limits in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
items.claim: Deterministic execution-layer control, not model capability, is the binding constraint on agentic trading alpha.

items.title: Named Entity Recognition for Unstructured Financial Transaction Text
items.claim: Span-matching architectures disambiguate financial transaction boundaries more efficiently than transformers under limited labeled data.

items.title: How Much is Too Much Optimism? Peer Tone Benchmarking and the Market Discount for Positive Tone Deviation
items.claim: Unverified peer-relative optimism in MD&A triggers a 2-4% market-to-book valuation penalty.

items.title: Can Machines Learn Electricity Hedging Regimes? State-Dependent Minimum-Variance Hedging in German Power Futures
items.claim: State-dependent hedging using neural network regime-weighting reduces power-futures tail risk by 10 EUR/MWh versus OLS.
